request:
Implement only a pure Luau sequential parkour checkpoint-state module, without instances, effects, assets or services. Return new(total), producing independent controllers initially at checkpoint 0 with zero wins. reach(index) returns true only when index is an integer in 1..total and equals current+1; duplicates, backwards visits, skips and invalid indices return false without changes. Completing the final checkpoint awards exactly one win. getCheckpoint(), getWins(), isFinished() expose state. respawn() returns the current checkpoint and retains progress. restart() returns progress to 0 while retaining wins; a new completed course can award one more win. files.source:
local Logic = {}
Logic.__index = Logic

function Logic.new(total)
	assert(type(total) == "number" and total >= 1 and math.floor(total) == total, "total must be a positive integer")
	local self = setmetatable({}, Logic)
	self.total = total
	self.currentCheckpoint = 0
	self.wins = 0
	self.finished = false
	return self
end

function Logic:reach(index)
	-- Validate index is integer within 1..total
	if type(index) ~= "number" or index % 1 ~= 0 or index < 1 or index > self.total then
		return false
	end
	-- Only allow reaching next checkpoint sequentially
	if index ~= self.currentCheckpoint + 1 then
		return false
	end
	-- Mark progress
	self.currentCheckpoint = index
	-- Check if finished
	if index == self.total then
		if not self.finished then
			self.wins = self.wins + 1
			self.finished = true
		end
	end
	return true
end

function Logic:getCheckpoint()
	return self.currentCheckpoint
end

function Logic:getWins()
	return self.wins
end

function Logic:isFinished()
	return self.finished
end

function Logic:respawn()
	-- Return current checkpoint, retain progress
	return self.currentCheckpoint
end

function Logic:restart()
	-- Reset progress but retain wins
	self.currentCheckpoint = 0
	self.finished = false
	return nil
end

return Logic
